name: params-large-integer-roundtrip
description: A 64-bit integer beyond 2^53-1 passed via params should round-trip through INSERT/SELECT unchanged, exactly like the BLOB round-trip in query-roundtrip.json (protocol.md's round-trip symmetry, testing.md's explicit large-integer round-trip check). Currently fails: san-db-ox v0.1.0 decodes params numbers through float64, silently corrupting the value and changing the stored SQLite column type from INTEGER to REAL.
